nodes.summary: For a finite family $K$ of finite subsets of $\mathbb{N}$ and $k \in \mathbb{N}$, the boundary matrix $\partial_k$ of $K$ is the matrix over $\mathbb{Q}$ whose rows are indexed by the faces of $K$ with $k$ vertices and whose columns are indexed by the faces of $K$ with $k + 1$ vertices; its entry at $(\tau, \sigma)$ is $(-1)^i$ when $\tau$ is obtained from $\sigma$ by removing its $i$-th smallest vertex, counting…
nodes.title: Simplicial boundary matrix

nodes.summary: For a finite family $K$ of finite subsets of $\mathbb{N}$ and $k \in \mathbb{N}$, the faces of $K$ with $k$ vertices are the members $\sigma \in K$ with exactly $k$ elements (the faces of dimension $k - 1$).
nodes.title: Faces with a given number of vertices

nodes.summary: For a finite family $K$ of finite subsets of $\mathbb{N}$, a finite set $F \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ is a facet of $K$ when $F \in K$ and $F$ is maximal under inclusion in $K$: every $G \in K$ with $F \subseteq G$ equals $F$.
nodes.title: Facet

nodes.summary: A finite family $K$ of finite subsets of $\mathbb{N}$ is rationally acyclic when its reduced Betti number indexed by $k$ is $0$ for every $k \in \mathbb{N}$.
nodes.title: Rationally acyclic complexes

nodes.summary: A finite family $K$ of finite subsets of $\mathbb{N}$ is a simplicial complex when it is closed under taking subsets: for every $\sigma \in K$ and every $\tau \subseteq \sigma$, we have $\tau \in K$.
nodes.title: Finite abstract simplicial complex

nodes.summary: For a finite family $K$ of finite subsets of $\mathbb{N}$ and a finite set $F \subseteq \mathbb{N}$, the link of $F$ in $K$ is $\operatorname{link}_K(F) = \{G \in K \mid G \cap F = \emptyset,\ G \cup F \in K\}$.
nodes.title: Link

nodes.summary: For a finite family $K$ of finite subsets of $\mathbb{N}$ and $k \in \mathbb{N}$, let $f_k$ be the number of faces of $K$ with $k$ vertices and let $\partial_k$ be the boundary matrix of $K$ from the faces with $k + 1$ vertices to the faces with $k$ vertices. The reduced Betti number of $K$ indexed by $k$ is the integer $f_k - \operatorname{rank} \partial_{k-1} - \operatorname{rank} \partial_k$, with ranks over…
nodes.title: Reduced rational Betti numbers

nodes.summary: For a finite family $K$ of finite subsets of $\mathbb{N}$, the largest face size of $K$ is the maximum number of elements of a member of $K$, and $0$ when $K$ is empty.
nodes.title: Largest face size

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
